    The extended Dynkin quiver of type E₇~ #

    The quiver LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE7 has a centre, a short arm consisting of one vertex, and two long arms of three vertices each: for i : Fin 2 an outer vertex outer i with one arrow into the middle vertex middle i, which has one arrow into the inner vertex inner i, which has one arrow into the centre; the short vertex has one arrow into the centre. Its underlying graph is the extended Dynkin diagram E₇~, the star with arms of lengths one, three and three, on eight vertices, here with every arrow pointing towards the centre. On the root-system side this is the star LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.starCartanMatrix ![1, 3, 3], which is the generalized Cartan matrix of LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.AffineDynkinType.E7 up to relabelling (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.AffineDynkinType.starCartanMatrix_one_three_three_eq_submatrix_E7).

    The arrows form the inductive family LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE7.Arrow, with one constructor for each kind of arrow, so that a definition by cases on an arrow lists exactly the arrows of E₇~.

    This file carries the vertex and arrow data, and the shape of the underlying graph: it is a tree, with at most one arrow between any two vertices, because every vertex is the source of at most one arrow and every arrow points towards the centre.

    Main definitions #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE7: the vertex type, with constructors center, short, inner, middle and outer, and a Quiver instance; it has eight vertices (LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE7.card_eq).
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE7.Arrow: the arrows outer i ⟶ middle i, middle i ⟶ inner i, inner i ⟶ center and short ⟶ center.

    References #

    • I. Assem, D. Simson, A. Skowroński, Elements of the Representation Theory of Associative Algebras, Volume I, Chapter VII.

    inductive LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE7 :
    Type

    The extended Dynkin quiver E₇~: a centre, a short arm of one vertex with an arrow into the centre, and two long arms, each an outer vertex with an arrow into a middle vertex, which has an arrow into an inner vertex, which has an arrow into the centre.

    • center : AffineE7

      The centre, the head of the arrows from the inner vertices and the short vertex.

    • short : AffineE7

      The vertex of the short arm, adjacent to the centre.

    • inner (i : Fin 2) : AffineE7

      The inner vertex of the long arm indexed by i, adjacent to the centre.

    • middle (i : Fin 2) : AffineE7

      The middle vertex of the long arm indexed by i.

    • outer (i : Fin 2) : AffineE7

      The outer vertex of the long arm indexed by i, the tail of a single arrow.
